crop_system: Annual row crop with winter cover
environment: Suitable annual-crop climates and soils in the 100-point frame
baseline: Named summer crop; explicit mineral N, irrigation, tillage, harvest and winter fallow
treatment: Winter cover established and fully terminated; cash-crop operations unchanged
frequency_duration: Annual autumn establishment and spring termination; 8 years as short-duration diagnostic
common_preparation: 8 and 16 baseline years; same full checkpoint within each pair
outcome: Soil C endpoint difference, growth and residue inputs; match depth before magnitude test
capability: Separate cover physiology is absent in single-PFT runs; establishment and termination must work
reuse: Weather, soil, parameters, PEcAn job inputs and converter
next_action: Revise establishment inputs and crop/cover physiology; pilot growth is insufficient for expansion

environment: Rice-compatible locations; pilot requires both rice vegetation and soil PFT
baseline: Explicit rice planting, fertilizer, harvest and seasonal flooding inputs
treatment: Omit irrigation in one or two specified 14-day windows; all other operations unchanged
frequency_duration: Every year; evaluate each drying-event class separately over matched seasons
common_preparation: 8 and 16 baseline years; same full checkpoint
outcome: Seasonal CH4 ratio plus realized soil water trajectory
evidence: Jiang et al. 2019 selected one/two-event classes
capability: Irrigation omission does not impose drainage; verify realized dry periods
reuse: Existing rice parameters, climate, event support and PEcAn conversion
next_action: Revise hydrologic intervention and crop growth; pilot interruptions do not consistently realize drying

environment: Dry/irrigated annual systems; exclude flooded rice where source excludes it
baseline: Documented conventional tillage dates and intensity with shared residues
treatment: Reduce or remove only tillage events
frequency_duration: Consistent annual schedule; distinguish under-10 and 10-or-more years
outcome: Soil C; mineral-N volatilization is diagnostic only
evidence: Sun et al. 2020; van Kessel et al. 2013
capability: Tillage affects decomposition; N2O species output unresolved
next_action: Specify source-matched duration; do not relabel 8 years as long-term
executable_specification: Assessment only; complete crop-specific operations and evidence matching before new runs
